findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vies_gleif_kyb_verify, iban_sepa_antifraud, email_deliverability_audit, b2b_tech_profiler, dora_third_party_risk, incident_severity_triage, lordo_netto_irpef_simulator, eu_pii_scrubber_anonymizer, gber_aid_intensity_checker, reach_svhc_threshold_screener, scip_notification_dossier_screener, pep_tiered_risk_assessor, food_contact_materials_fcm_screener, mdr_vigilance_reporting_timeline_calculator · Private data: email_deliverability_audit, port_leak_detector, eu_pii_scrubber_anonymizer, eu_synthetic_data_masker, xbrl_statement_normalizer, cpv_code_classifier_validator, scip_notification_dossier_screener, food_contact_materials_fcm_screener · Public sink: iban_sepa_antifraud, dcf_wacc_valuation, email_deliverability_audit, lordo_netto_irpef_simulator, reach_svhc_threshold_screener, scip_notification_dossier_screener, pep_tiered_risk_assessor · Destructive: iban_sepa_antifraud, eu_synthetic_data_masker, eudamed_udi_di_validator.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "einvoice_xml_auditor" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Read-only, side-effect free]. Audits Italian FatturaPA 1.2.2 and Peppol BIS 3.0 electronic invoice XML against official SDI XSD schemas and error rules (004xx/003xx, rounding, Bollo > 77.47€), or generates schema-valid FatturaPA XML.
